03Case study

AI Facial RecognitionAttendance System

An automated attendance system that recognises faces with computer vision, replacing manual registers with a faster and more secure record.

Category
Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision
Year
2026
My role
Final-year project
Status
Live

The problem

Paper registers and manual roll calls are slow, easy to falsify and hard to audit. Institutions need attendance records they can trust without adding work for staff.

What I built

For my final-year project in Electrical/Electronic Engineering I designed and implemented an automated attendance management system built on artificial intelligence and computer vision.

I developed the facial detection and recognition algorithms that identify each person and record their attendance, giving a seamless, secure and efficient alternative to manual tracking. Administrators review sessions and records through a web dashboard.

What it does

  • Facial detection and recognition for check-in
  • Automatic attendance records per session
  • A live overview with intruder alerts and attendance rate
  • CSV export of records
  • An admin dashboard for review

Tools and technologies

  • Computer vision
  • Facial detection
  • Facial recognition
  • Raspberry Pi 4
  • Web admin dashboard
  • Firebase
